text: Units be advised, lightning within eight miles, weather hold on the main stage
Shots fired near the north gate, multiple callers
Command to all units, evacuate the campground, move everyone to the parking lots
Crowd surge at the barricade front of house, barricade down
The tunnel is flooding again, standing water knee deep
Smoke showing from a tent in the east camp
Missing child, six years old, last seen near the ferris wheel
Medic 2, unresponsive male behind stage two, possible overdose
Route 129 closed at the bridge, gridlock back to the interstate
Copy, unit 12 en route to the command post
